mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID AS "groupId", TITLE AS "title", OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", STATUS AS "status", PURPOSE AS "purpose", REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", AMOUNT AS "amount", MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", MONTHS AS "months", PAY_DAY AS "payDay", ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", VISIBILITY AS "visibility", DESCRIPTION AS "description", 'OWNER' AS "role" FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE OWNER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY GROUP_ID DESC

SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", G.TITLE AS "title", G.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", G.STATUS AS "status", G.PURPOSE AS "purpose", G.REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", G.REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", G.AMOUNT AS "amount", G.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", G.MONTHS AS "months", G.PAY_DAY AS "payDay", G.ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", G.VISIBILITY AS "visibility", G.DESCRIPTION AS "description", 'MEMBER' AS "role" FROM GYE_GROUP G WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) AND G.OWNER_ID != #{memberId} ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID DESC
